cli-a2a.description: Muingiliano na seva ya OmniRoute A2A kutoka kwenye CLI. Tuma kazi, kagua historia ya utekelezaji wa ujuzi, na ujaribu itifaki ya wakala-kwa-wakala ya JSON-RPC 2.0 kwa mwingiliano.
cli-a2a.name: CLI: Itifaki ya A2A

cli-backup-sync.description: Hifadhi nakala na urejeshe data ya OmniRoute kutoka kwenye CLI. Anzisha picha za nyongeza (snapshots), sawazisha kwenye hifadhi ya wingu, dhibiti ratiba za kuhifadhi nakala, na urejeshe kutoka kwenye faili za kumbukumbu.
cli-backup-sync.name: CLI: Hifadhi Nakala na Usawazishaji

cli-batches.description: Wasilisha na ufuatilie kazi za makundi ya makisio (batch inference) kutoka kwenye CLI. Pakia na udhibiti faili kwa ajili ya usindikaji wa makundi, pata matokeo, na unganisha mabomba ya makundi na mitiririko ya kazi ya CI/CD.
cli-batches.name: CLI: Makundi na Faili

cli-chat.description: Tuma ukamilishaji wa soga, tiririsha majibu, na uanzishe kipindi shirikishi cha REPL kutoka kwenye CLI. Inasaidia watoa huduma wote wa OmniRoute, uelekezaji wa mchanganyiko, na usanidi wa kidokezo cha mfumo.
cli-chat.name: CLI: Chat

cli-compression.description: Sanidi na ujaribu mgandamizo wa kidokezo kutoka kwenye CLI. Dhibiti vichujio vya RTK, sheria za Caveman, hali za mgandamizo zilizopangwa, na uhakiki matokeo ya mgandamizo kwa kutumia vidokezo halisi.
cli-compression.name: CLI: Compression

cli-contexts.description: Dhibiti usanidi wa uhandisi wa muktadha, seti za vichujio vya RTK, na vipindi vya mazungumzo kutoka kwenye CLI. Tuma mipangilio ya uwasilishaji wa muktadha na ukague mifereji ya muktadha inayofanya kazi.
cli-contexts.name: CLI: Contexts & Sessions

cli-cost-usage.description: Angalia mchanganuo wa gharama, matumizi ya tokeni, na kumbukumbu za simu kutoka kwenye CLI. Chuja kwa mtoa huduma, mfano, au muda wa tarehe. Hamisha ripoti za matumizi na ukague matumizi kwa kila muunganisho.
cli-cost-usage.name: CLI: Cost & Usage

cli-eval.description: Unda na uendeshe seti za tathmini, tazama maendeleo ya kipimo cha utendaji mubashara, angalia kadi za alama, linganisha utendaji wa mfano, na unganisha uendeshaji wa tathmini na mitiririko ya kazi ya CI kutoka kwenye CLI.
cli-eval.name: CLI: Tathmini

cli-health.description: Angalia afya ya seva, hali ya vipengele, na vipimo vya moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye CLI. Endesha `health`, `health components`, na `health watch` kwa ajili ya dashibodi ya wakati halisi ya vivunja mzunguko na hali ya mtoa huduma.
cli-health.name: CLI: Health

cli-keys.description: Unda, orodhesha, zungusha, na ubatilishe funguo za API za OmniRoute kutoka kwenye CLI. Dhibiti mtiririko wa OAuth kwa uthibitishaji wa mtoa huduma na ukague mawanda ya funguo na muda wa kuisha.
cli-keys.name: CLI: API Keys

cli-mcp.description: Kagua hali ya seva ya MCP, orodhesha zana na upeo uliosajiliwa, endesha wito wa zana, na udhibiti kumbukumbu za ukaguzi za MCP kutoka kwenye CLI.
cli-mcp.name: CLI: MCP

cli-models.description: Uliza mifano ya AI inayopatikana, orodhesha majina mbadala ya mifano, na vinjari katalogi kamili ya mifano kutoka kwenye CLI. Chuja kwa mtoa huduma, tafuta kwa uwezo, na utatue lahaja za majina ya mifano.
cli-models.name: CLI: Models

cli-plugins-skills.description: Dhibiti Ujuzi wa Omni (orodhesha, sakinisha, jaribu, ondoa), programu-jalizi (unda, usanidi), na kumbukumbu ya kudumu (tafuta, ongeza, futa) kutoka kwenye CLI.
cli-plugins-skills.name: CLI: Programu-jalizi, Ujuzi na Kumbukumbu

cli-policy-audit.description: Kagua kumbukumbu za ukaguzi, dhibiti sera za ufikiaji, angalia data ya telemetri, na uhakiki historia ya maombi kutoka kwenye CLI. Chuja kwa aina ya tukio, mtumiaji, au muda wa muda kwa mtiririko wa kazi wa kufuata sheria.
cli-policy-audit.name: CLI: Sera na Ukaguzi

cli-providers.description: Dhibiti miunganisho ya watoa huduma kutoka kwenye CLI: orodhesha watoa huduma wanaopatikana/waliosanidiwa, ongeza, jaribu, jaribu-yote, thibitisha, zungusha funguo za API, na uangalie vipimo vya kila mtoa huduma.
cli-providers.name: CLI: Providers

cli-resilience.description: Kagua na udhibiti hali za vivunja mzunguko, muda wa kupumzika kwa miunganisho, mipaka ya upendeleo, na viwango vya kurudi nyuma kutoka kwenye CLI. Weka upya watoa huduma waliokwama na usanidi vizingiti vya ustahimilivu.
cli-resilience.name: CLI: Resilience & Quotas

cli-routing.description: Unda, orodhesha, sasisha, na ufute mchanganyiko wa uelekezaji kutoka kwenye CLI. Jaribu mikakati ya uelekezaji, kagua vipimo vya mchanganyiko, na usanidi minyororo ya dharura kwa njia shirikishi.
cli-routing.name: CLI: Routing & Combos

cli-serve.description: Anzisha, simamisha, na uanzishe upya seva ya OmniRoute kutoka kwenye CLI. Dhibiti hali ya daemon, usanidi wa mlango, urejeshi wa kiotomatiki, ujumuishaji wa trei ya mfumo, na njia ya mkato ya kufungua dashibodi.
cli-serve.name: CLI: Serve

cli-setup.description: Endesha usanidi wa kwanza, usanidi mipangilio ya kimataifa ya CLI, dhibiti vigeuzi vya mazingira, angalia sasisho, na usanidi uanzishaji otomatiki kupitia amri za usanidi na uwekaji mipangilio za CLI.
cli-setup.name: CLI: Usanidi na Uwekaji Mipangilio

cli-skill-collector.description: Tambua zana za usimbaji za CLI zilizosakinishwa (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Cline na zaidi), tafuta GitHub kwa ujuzi unaolingana wa wakala, na uzisakinishe kwenye zana zilizotambuliwa kupitia API zilizojengwa ndani za OmniRoute.
cli-skill-collector.name: CLI: Mkusanyaji wa Ujuzi wa Wakala

cli-tunnel.description: Anzisha na usimamishe miunganisho ya tunnel (ngrok, Cloudflare, maalum) kutoka kwenye CLI. Kagua URL za tunnel zinazofanya kazi, usanidi uthibitishaji, na ujaribu ufikiaji wa nje.
cli-tunnel.name: CLI: Tunnels

config-codex-cli.description: Mtiririko wa kazi wa wakala wa hatua kwa hatua ili kusanidi OpenAI Codex CLI kwenye mashine yoyote (Linux, macOS, Windows) ili kutumia OmniRoute kama mfumo wa nyuma unaoendana na OpenAI. Inatambua OS na shell, inaandika config.toml na wasifu 7 zilizotajwa, inaweka vigeuzi vya mazingira, na inathibitisha usanidi.
config-codex-cli.name: Usanidi: Codex CLI

omni-agents-a2a.description: Muingiliano na OmniRoute kupitia itifaki ya ejenti-kwa-ejenti ya JSON-RPC 2.0. Ujuzi 6 wa ndani wa A2A: smart-routing, quota-management, provider-discovery, cost-analysis, health-report, list-capabilities.
omni-agents-a2a.name: Ejenti na Itifaki ya A2A

omni-api-keys.description: Unda, orodhesha, zungusha, na ubatilishe funguo za API za OmniRoute. Dhibiti upeo wa kila ufunguo, vikomo vya matumizi, na muda wa mwisho wa matumizi. Funguo hudhibiti ufikiaji wa vituo vyote vya proksi na usimamizi.
omni-api-keys.name: Funguo za API

omni-auth.description: Dhibiti uthibitishaji wa ufunguo wa API na tokeni za kipindi. Anzia hapa ili kuthibitisha maombi kupitia tokeni ya Bearer, kupata vidakuzi vya kipindi, na kusanidi mahitaji ya kuingia kwa API ya OmniRoute.
omni-auth.name: Uthibitishaji

omni-budget.description: Sanidi vikomo vya matumizi, viwango vya tokeni, na sera za kikomo cha kasi kwa kila ufunguo wa API au kimataifa. Kagua matumizi ya sasa na utekeleze udhibiti wa gharama kwa watoa huduma wote.
omni-budget.name: Bajeti na Vikomo vya Kasi

omni-cache.description: Dhibiti kache ya majibu ya LLM. Tazama takwimu za kache, futa maingizo, sanidi sera za TTL, na udhibiti vizingiti vya uhifadhi wa kache kulingana na ufanano wa kisemantiki.
omni-cache.name: Kache

omni-cli-tools.description: Dhibiti ujumuishaji wa zana za CLI unaofunuliwa kupitia API. Orodhesha, usanidi, na uanzishe programu-jalizi za zana za CLI zinazopanua eneo la otomatiki la OmniRoute.
omni-cli-tools.name: Zana za CLI

omni-combos-routing.description: Unda na udhibiti michanganyiko ya uelekezaji yenye mikakati 14 (kipaumbele, uzani, round-robin, Auto-combo, n.k.). Sanidi minyororo ya dharura, jaribu matokeo ya uelekezaji, na urejeshe vipimo vya mchanganyiko.
omni-combos-routing.name: Michanganyiko na Uelekezaji

omni-compression.description: Sanidi hali za mgandamizo za RTK (matokeo ya amri), Caveman (nathari), na zilizopangwa kwa tabaka. Dhibiti vifurushi vya lugha, sheria maalum, na jaribu mgandamizo wa vidokezo unaopunguza tokeni kwa 60–90%.
omni-compression.name: Mgandamizo

omni-context-rtk.description: Sanidi vichujio vya RTK, sheria za uhandisi wa muktadha, na mipangilio ya upeanaji wa muktadha. Jaribu mgandamizo kwa sampuli halisi za vidokezo na udhibiti mifereji ya mabadiliko ya muktadha.
omni-context-rtk.name: Muktadha na RTK

omni-db-backups.description: Anzisha chelezo za mfumo, rejesha kutoka kwenye faili za chelezo, na udhibiti mzunguko wa maisha wa hifadhidata ya SQLite. Inasaidia mikakati ya kuhamisha, kuingiza, na picha za haraka za nyongeza.
omni-db-backups.name: Hifadhidata na Chelezo

omni-github-skills.description: Tafuta, toa alama, kagua, na uagize ujuzi wa wakala kutoka kwenye hazina za GitHub zilizo na SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, na faili zinazofanana za ujuzi wa wakala. Gundua ujuzi wa jamii katika kategoria 160+ za watoa huduma, tathmini umuhimu kwa alama za kiheuristiki, kagua programu hasidi au siri zilizowekwa ngumu (hardcoded secrets), na usakinishe kwenye saraka za wakala za Hermes, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, au OpenCode.
omni-github-skills.name: Ugunduzi wa Ujuzi wa GitHub

omni-inference.description: Vituo vya mwisho vya udadisi vya msingi vinavyoendana na OpenAI: ukamilishaji wa soga, upachikaji, picha, sauti (TTS/STT), ulinganifu, kupanga upya, na Responses API. Eneo la msingi la ujumuishaji kwa ejenti za AI.
omni-inference.name: Udadisi (Inayoendana na OpenAI)

omni-mcp.description: Unganisha kwenye seva ya OmniRoute MCP (zana 37, usafirishaji 3: SSE/stdio/HTTP). Inajumuisha uelekezaji, kache, mgandamizo, kumbukumbu, ujuzi, watoa huduma, na zana za ukaguzi kwenye mawanda 16 ya ruhusa.
omni-mcp.name: Seva ya MCP

omni-models.description: Dadisi modeli za AI zinazopatikana katika watoa huduma wote waliowekwa. Orodhesha modeli, tatua lakabu za modeli, na uvinjari katalogi kamili ya modeli ikijumuisha lahaja mahususi za watoa huduma.
omni-models.name: Modeli

omni-providers.description: Dhibiti miunganisho ya watoa huduma, funguo za API, mtiririko wa OAuth, na majaribio ya muunganisho kupitia REST API. Orodhesha, ongeza, sasisha, ondoa, na jaribu miunganisho ya watoa huduma wa AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, na 160+).
omni-providers.name: Watoa Huduma

omni-proxies.description: Sanidi proksi za HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS kwa maombi ya mtoa huduma wa juu. Weka sheria za proksi kwa kila mtoa huduma au za jumla, jaribu muunganisho, na udhibiti mzunguko wa proksi.
omni-proxies.name: Usanidi wa Proksi

omni-resilience.description: Fuatilia afya ya mtoa huduma, hali za kikatamzunguko, vipimo vya muda wa kusubiri vya p50/p95/p99, na arifa za ulinzi wa bajeti. Kagua vipindi vya kupumzisha muunganisho na kufungiwa kwa modeli katika muda halisi.
omni-resilience.name: Ustahimilivu na Ufuatiliaji

omni-settings.description: Soma na usasishe mipangilio ya jumla ya programu: vidokezo vya mfumo, bajeti ya kufikiri, vichujio vya IP, sheria za mzigo wa data, chaguomsingi za mchanganyiko, na usanidi wa kuhitaji kuingia.
omni-settings.name: Mipangilio

omni-sync-cloud.description: Landanisha usanidi wa OmniRoute, miunganisho ya watoa huduma, na mipangilio kwenda/kutoka kwenye hifadhi ya wingu. Dhibiti uthibitishaji wa wafanyakazi wa wingu na shabaha za chelezo za mbali.
omni-sync-cloud.name: Ulandanishaji wa Wingu

omni-tunnels.description: Unda na udhibiti taneli salama (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, maalum) ili kufunua OmniRoute kwenye mtandao wa intaneti au kushiriki ufikiaji na ejenti za mbali na mifereji ya CI.
omni-tunnels.name: Taneli

omni-usage-logs.description: Fikia kumbukumbu za kina za miito na uchanganuzi wa matumizi. Chuja kulingana na mtoa huduma, modeli, masafa ya muda, hali, na gharama. Hamisha kumbukumbu na ujumlishe matumizi ya tokeni katika miunganisho yote.
omni-usage-logs.name: Matumizi na Kumbukumbu

omni-version-manager.description: Sakinisha, anzisha, simamisha, anzisha upya, na usasishe huduma zilizopachikwa (9Router, CLIProxyAPI). Fuatilia hali ya huduma, pata kumbukumbu za matukio, na usanidi uanzishaji wa kiotomatiki kwa vituo vya mwisho vya huduma za ndani pekee.
omni-version-manager.name: Kidhibiti cha Toleo

omni-webhooks.description: Sajili, orodhesha, jaribu, na uondoe vituo vya mwisho vya webhook. Sanidi usajili wa matukio (request.completed, provider.error, budget.exceeded, n.k.) na udhibiti majaribio tena ya uwasilishaji.
omni-webhooks.name: Webhooks

toolUseCases.custom: Use for custom tool implementations or generic OpenAI-compatible configurations.
toolUseCases.droid: Use when you need a lightweight terminal agent focused on fast coding and command execution loops.
toolUseCases.hermes: Use when you need a lightweight terminal-native AI assistant for quick tasks.

toolUseCases.kiro: Use when integrating Kiro and controlling model routing centrally from OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.openclaw: Use when you want an Open Claw style coding agent but routed through OmniRoute policies.
toolUseCases.opencode: Use when you prefer terminal-native agent runs and scripted automation via OpenCode.
toolUseCases.qwen: Use when you need Alibaba Qwen Code CLI for coding tasks.
toolUseCases.windsurf: Use when you want an AI-first IDE with Codeium/Windsurf models routed through OmniRoute.

combos.saveBlockedTitle: Save is blocked until the following items are fixed:

auto.avoid: Avoid when you need strict priority ordering or historical persistence.
auto.example: Example: Balance requests across models with different strengths.
auto.when: Use when you need multi-factor scoring routing based on cost, latency, and quality.

context-optimized.avoid: Avoid when models have similar context lengths or tasks are simple.
context-optimized.example: Example: Distribute long conversations across models with larger context windows.
context-optimized.when: Use when you need to optimize context window usage across models.

context-relay.avoid: Avoid when account switching is rare or when you do not want extra summarization requests.
context-relay.example: Example: Codex sessions that rotate across multiple accounts near quota exhaustion.
context-relay.when: Use when long sessions must survive account rotation without losing the working context.

cost-optimized.avoid: Pricing data is missing or outdated.
cost-optimized.example: Background or batch jobs where lower cost is preferred.
cost-optimized.when: Cost reduction is your top priority.

fill-first.avoid: Avoid when you need request-level load balancing across providers.
fill-first.example: Example: Use all $200 Deepgram credits before falling back to Groq.
fill-first.when: Use when you want to fully exhaust one provider's quota before moving to the next.

least-used.avoid: Traffic is too low to benefit from usage balancing.
least-used.example: Mixed workloads where one model often gets overloaded.
least-used.when: You want adaptive balancing based on live demand.

lkgp.avoid: Avoid when historical data is limited or unreliable.
lkgp.example: Example: Route to models with a good track record on specific tasks.
lkgp.when: Use when you want to route based on historical success rates and performance.

p2c.avoid: Avoid for small combos with 2 or fewer models — no benefit over round-robin.
p2c.example: Example: High-throughput inference across 4+ equivalent model endpoints.
p2c.when: Use when you want low-latency selection using Power-of-Two-Choices algorithm.

priority.avoid: You need request distribution across models.
priority.example: Primary coding model with cheaper backup for outages.
priority.when: You have one preferred model and only want fallback on failure.

random.when: You want simple distribution with minimal setup.

reset-aware.avoid: Kiwango cha telemetry hakipatikani kwa akaunti nyingi.
reset-aware.example: Pendelea 60% ya kila wiki ya kuweka upya akaunti kesho juu ya 80% ya kuweka upya akaunti baadaye.
reset-aware.when: Unapitia akaunti nyingi ukitumia telemetry ya kiasi na madirisha tofauti ya kuweka upya.

round-robin.avoid: Models differ too much in latency or cost.
round-robin.example: Same model on multiple accounts to spread throughput.
round-robin.when: You want predictable and even distribution.

strict-random.avoid: Avoid when models have different quality or latency and order matters.
strict-random.example: Example: Multiple accounts of the same model to distribute usage evenly.
strict-random.when: Use when you want perfectly even spread — each model used once before repeating.

weighted.avoid: You cannot maintain accurate weights over time.
weighted.when: You need controlled traffic split across models.

auto.description: Route based on real-time scoring for cost, latency, quality, and health.
auto.tip1: Let the engine balance multiple factors automatically.
auto.tip2: Monitor which factors drive routing decisions in logs.
auto.tip3: Use for complex workloads where no single factor dominates.
auto.title: Multi-Factor Optimization

context-optimized.description: Optimize routing based on context window usage and token efficiency.
context-optimized.tip1: Route long conversations to models with larger context windows.
context-optimized.tip2: Monitor context utilization to avoid token waste.
context-optimized.tip3: Best for conversational AI requiring extensive context retention.
context-optimized.title: Context Optimization

context-relay.description: Best when account rotation is expected and the next account must inherit a simplified task summary.
context-relay.tip1: Use with providers rotating accounts for the same model family.
context-relay.tip2: Set handoff threshold below hard quota cutoffs for summary generation time.
context-relay.tip3: Only set a dedicated summary model if the primary is too expensive or unstable.
context-relay.title: Session Continuity Priority

cost-optimized.description: Routes to lower-cost models when pricing metadata is available.
cost-optimized.tip1: Ensure pricing coverage for all selected models.
cost-optimized.tip2: Keep a quality fallback for hard prompts.
cost-optimized.tip3: Use for batch/background jobs where cost is the main KPI.
cost-optimized.title: Budget-first routing

fill-first.description: Exhaust provider quotas sequentially before falling back.
fill-first.tip1: Use for quota-based routing with clear fallback chains.
fill-first.tip2: Set quotas accurately to avoid premature fallback.
fill-first.tip3: Works best with providers offering free tiers or credit buckets.
fill-first.title: Quota Exhaustion

least-used.description: Routes to less-used models to reduce hotspots over time.
least-used.tip2: Combine with health checks for safer balancing.
least-used.tip3: Track per-model usage to validate distribution gains.
least-used.title: Adaptive balancing

lkgp.description: Route based on historical performance and success patterns.
lkgp.tip1: Requires sufficient request history for accurate predictions.
lkgp.tip2: Good for workloads with consistent model performance patterns.
lkgp.tip3: Monitor prediction accuracy and adjust weights as needed.
lkgp.title: History-Based Routing

p2c.description: Route to the provider with the lowest current load based on real-time metrics.
p2c.tip1: Monitor provider health metrics for accurate load assessment.
p2c.tip2: Works best with homogeneous provider pools.
p2c.tip3: Adjust sensitivity to avoid oscillation during traffic spikes.
p2c.title: Power of Two Choices

priority.description: Use one primary model and keep fallback chain short and reliable.
priority.tip1: Put your most reliable model first.
priority.tip2: Keep 1-2 backup models with similar quality.
priority.tip3: Use safe retries to absorb transient provider failures.
priority.title: Fail-safe baseline

random.description: Use when you need simple distribution without strict guarantees.
random.tip1: Use models with similar latency profiles.
random.tip2: Keep retries enabled to absorb random misses.
random.tip3: Prefer this for experimentation, not strict SLAs.
random.title: Quick spread with low setup

reset-aware.description: Husawazisha mgao uliosalia wa mtoa huduma dhidi ya kuweka upya muda.
reset-aware.tip1: Tumia hatua za akaunti wazi au uelekezaji wa lebo ya akaunti kwa watoa huduma walio na kiwango cha telemetry.
reset-aware.tip2: Rejesha kipindi dhidi ya uzani wa kila wiki wakati uchovu wa muda mfupi ni hatari zaidi.
reset-aware.tip3: Weka bendi ndogo ili akaunti zinazolingana bado zizunguke kwa usawa.
reset-aware.title: Weka upya-kufahamu mzunguko wa akaunti

round-robin.description: Best when models are equivalent and you need smooth distribution.
round-robin.tip2: Set concurrency limits to avoid burst overload.
round-robin.tip3: Use queue timeout to fail fast under saturation.
round-robin.title: Predictable load sharing

strict-random.description: Each model is used exactly once per cycle before reshuffling.
strict-random.tip1: Use at least 2 models for meaningful distribution.
strict-random.tip3: Ideal for load balancing across multiple API accounts.
strict-random.title: Shuffle deck distribution

weighted.description: Great for canary rollouts and gradual migration between models.
weighted.tip2: Keep the total at 100% and auto-balance after changes.
weighted.tip3: Monitor success and latency before increasing canary weight.
weighted.title: Controlled traffic split

docs.clientClineBullet1: Cline works best with explicit provider/model prefixes so the router never has to guess the backend.
docs.clientClineBullet2: Use `/v1/chat/completions` for general models and reuse the same OmniRoute base URL across different accounts.
docs.clientClineBullet3: Use the Providers dashboard to validate OAuth/API key before debugging Cline runtime issues.
docs.clientCursorBullet2: OAuth connection - login from the Providers page.
docs.clientKimiBullet1: Use OmniRoute as a stable base URL while rotating accounts or provider combos underneath.
docs.clientKimiBullet2: Prefer prefixed models in coding flows so fallback and audit trail remain explicit.
docs.clientKimiBullet3: Use `/v1/responses` when you want native Responses-style routing for tool-using clients.
docs.clientWindsurfBullet1: Use OmniRoute as an OpenAI-compatible base URL and keep explicit provider prefixes for deterministic routing.
docs.clientWindsurfBullet2: Point models to `/v1/chat/completions` for general traffic and preserve `/v1/responses` for Codex-style flows.
docs.clientWindsurfBullet3: Use Dashboard -> CLI Tools for a ready-made Windsurf configuration guide.
docs.deployDockerText: Usambazaji wa vyombo na Docker Compose; tayari kwa mkusanyiko wa uzalishaji na Kubernetes.
docs.deployElectronText: Endesha OmniRoute kama programu asilia ya eneo-kazi kwenye Windows, macOS, na Linux.
docs.deployFlyText: Sambaza hadi Fly.io edge wakati wa utekelezaji kwa fly.toml moja na amri moja ya kusambaza.
docs.deployPwaText: Sakinisha OmniRoute kama Programu Inayoendelea ya Wavuti kwenye vivinjari vya Android, iOS na eneo-kazi.
docs.deploySetupText: Usakinishaji wa hatua kwa hatua, usanidi wa mazingira, na mapitio ya mara ya kwanza ya OmniRoute.
docs.deployTermuxText: Run OmniRoute headless on Android via Termux. Access the dashboard from your mobile browser.
docs.deployVmText: Mwenyeji mwenyewe kwenye Linux VM yoyote. Inajumuisha kitengo cha mfumo, mzunguko wa kumbukumbu, na zana za kuhifadhi nakala.
docs.docsHeroDescription: AI gateway for multi-provider LLMs. One endpoint for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and 100+ more providers.
docs.endpointBatchesNote: Batch processing for bulk API requests.
docs.endpointCompletionsNote: Legacy completions endpoint for text generation.
docs.endpointCountTokensNote: Count tokens for a given message payload.
docs.endpointModelsNote: Model catalog for all connected providers.
docs.endpointRerankNote: Document reranking for retrieval-augmented generation (Cohere, Jina).
docs.endpointRewriteModelsNote: Rewrite helper for model discovery without /v1.
docs.endpointSearchAnalyticsNote: Analytics and metrics for search requests.
docs.endpointSearchNote: Web search with 5 providers (Serper, Brave, Exa, Tavily, Perplexity).
docs.featureAcpText: Agent Communication Protocol (ACP) registry for managing agent-to-agent workflows and tool orchestration.
docs.featureAnalyticsText: Visual analytics with charts for requests, tokens, errors, latency, costs, and model popularity over time.
docs.featureAutoComboText: Automatically create optimized combos based on your connected providers, usage patterns, and model capabilities.
docs.featureCliText: Manage IDE configurations, export/import backups, discover codex profiles, and configure settings from the dashboard.
docs.featureCloudSyncText: Sync your configuration to Cloudflare Workers for remote access with encrypted credentials and automatic failover.
docs.featureCombosText: Create model combos with fallback chains and balancing strategies: round-robin, priority, random, least-used, and cost-optimized.
docs.featureHealthText: Live health checks, provider status, circuit breaker states, and automatic rate limit detection with exponential backoff.
docs.featureMemoryText: Persistent conversational memory with extraction, injection, retrieval, and summarization across sessions.
docs.featureRoutingText: Route requests to 30+ AI providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supports chat, responses, audio, and image APIs.
docs.featureSearchText: Integrated web search with 5 providers (Serper, Brave, Exa, Tavily, Perplexity) including analytics and cost tracking.
docs.featureSecurityText: API key authentication, IP filtering, prompt injection guard, domain policies, session management, and audit logging.
docs.featureSkillsText: Extensible skill system with built-in and custom skills, sandbox execution, request interception, and context injection.
docs.featureUsageText: Real-time token counting, cost calculation per provider/model, and detailed usage breakdown by API key and account.
docs.fullStreaming: Full streaming support for all models.
docs.managementApiDescription: Automation endpoints for proxy registry, scope assignments, and legacy proxy migration.

docs.protocolTroubleshooting1: If MCP status is offline, verify the stdio process is running and heartbeat file is updating.

docs.protocolTroubleshooting3: Use `/dashboard/mcp` and `/dashboard/a2a` for operational controls and audit visibility.
docs.protocolsDescription: OmniRoute exposes two operational protocols in addition to OpenAI-compatible APIs: MCP for tool execution and A2A for agent-to-agent workflows.

docs.troubleshootingAmbiguousModels: If you receive ambiguous model errors, pick a provider prefix instead of a bare model ID.
docs.troubleshootingCircuitBreaker: If a provider shows circuit breaker open, wait for the cooldown or check Health page for details.
docs.troubleshootingCodexFamily: For GitHub Codex-family models, keep model as gh/codex-model; router selects /responses automatically.
docs.troubleshootingModelRouting: If the client fails with model routing, use explicit provider/model (for example: gh/gpt-5.1-codex).
docs.troubleshootingOAuth: For OAuth providers, re-authenticate if tokens expire. Check the provider card status indicator.
docs.troubleshootingTestConnection: Use Dashboard > Providers > Test Connection before testing from IDEs or external clients.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_LOCAL_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Ruhusu watoa huduma kwenye localhost, LAN, na masafa ya IP ya faragha. Hii inahitajika kwa mifano ya ndani inayoendana na OpenAI na imewezeshwa kwa chaguomsingi. Vituo vya mwisho vya cloud-metadata kama vile 169.254.169.254 vinasalia kuzuiwa.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Ruhusu URL za mtoa huduma zinazoelekeza kwenye mitandao ya faragha au ya ndani.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CLAUDE_PROFILES.description: Baada ya ulandanishi wa mtoa huduma na mfano, zalisha upya wasifu wa ~/.claude/profiles/{name}/settings.json kutoka kwenye katalogi hai. Hii haibadilishi kamwe usanidi amilifu au wa chaguomsingi wa Claude na imezimwa kwa chaguomsingi.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CODEX_PROFILES.description: Baada ya ulandanishi wa mtoa huduma na mfano, zalisha upya wasifu wa ~/.codex/*.config.toml kutoka kwenye katalogi hai. Hii haibadilishi kamwe usanidi amilifu au wa chaguomsingi wa Codex na imezimwa kwa chaguomsingi.

OMNIROUTE_CODEX_WS_ENABLED.description: Ruhusu Codex kutumia Responses kupitia WebSocket. Inapozimwa, Codex hurudi kwenye HTTP Responses.

OMNIROUTE_CONTROL_PLANE_PROXY_DIRECT_FAL.description: Ruhusu mtiririko wa OAuth na uthibitishaji wa mtoa huduma kupita seva mbadala iliyobandikwa wakati ukaguzi wa ufikiaji wa seva mbadala unapofeli. Imezimwa kwa chaguomsingi kwa sababu hii inaweza kubadilisha IP ya kutokea ya akaunti.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_SERVICES.description: Zima huduma zote za nyuma, ikijumuisha uboreshaji wa upya wa viwango na ulandanishi.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_LOCAL_HEALTHCHECK.description: Zima kituo cha mwisho cha ukaguzi wa afya wa mfano wa ndani.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_TOKEN_HEALTHCHECK.description: Zima ukaguzi wa afya wa uthibitishaji wa tokeni.

OMNIROUTE_EMERGENCY_FALLBACK.description: Elekeza maombi ya bajeti iliyoisha kwa mtoa huduma na mfano mbadala wa dharura wa bure.

OMNIROUTE_ENABLE_LIVE_WS.description: Anzisha seva ya WebSocket ya dashibodi ya muda halisi wakati wa kuagiza kwenye lango la loopback 20132. Weka alama kuwa 0 au false ili kuizima. Mfiduo wa LAN pia unahitaji LIVE_WS_HOST=0.0.0.0 na LIVE_WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

OMNIROUTE_ENABLE_RUNTIME_BACKGROUND_TASK.description: Wezesha usindikaji wa kazi za nyuma wakati wa uendeshaji.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_COMPRESS_DESCRIPTIONS.description: Fupisha maelezo ya zana ya MCP ili kupunguza matumizi ya tokeni.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_ENFORCE_SCOPES.description: Tekeleza vizuizi vya upeo kwa ufikiaji wa zana ya MCP.

OMNIROUTE_RTK_TRUST_PROJECT_FILTERS.description: Amini vichujio vya RTK vya kiwango cha mradi bila uthibitishaji.

OUTBOUND_SSRF_GUARD_ENABLED.description: Zuia maombi ya nje kwenda kwenye masafa ya IP ya faragha au ya ndani.

PII_REDACTION_ENABLED.description: Ficha taarifa zinazoweza kumtambulisha mtu binafsi kutoka kwenye maombi.

PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION.description: Safisha taarifa zinazoweza kumtambulisha mtu binafsi katika majibu ya mtoa huduma.

PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION_MODE.description: Chagua jinsi PII ya majibu inavyoshughulikiwa: redact huibadilisha, warn huirekodi tu kwenye kumbukumbu, block hukataa jibu, na off huzima usafishaji.

PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Lanisha data ya bei kiotomatiki. Tofauti ya mazingira ya PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED lazima pia iwe true.

PROXY_AUTO_SELECT_ENABLED.description: Wakati hakuna seva mbadala iliyogawiwa kwenye muunganisho, chagua kiotomatiki seva mbadala ya kwanza ya sajili inayofanya kazi. Imezimwa kwa chaguomsingi kwa sababu vinginevyo seva mbadala moja ya sajili inakuwa mbadala wa kimataifa kwa trafiki yote (#3332).

RATE_LIMIT_AUTO_ENABLE.description: Wezesha kiotomatiki ukomo wa kasi kulingana na mifumo ya matumizi.

REQUIRE_API_KEY.description: Hitaji ufunguo wa API kwa maombi yote yanayoingia.

RESPONSES_PASSTHROUGH_DROP_COMMENTARY.description: Ondoa vipengele vya pato la awamu ya maoni ya ndani kutoka kwenye mikondo ya kupita ya Responses API kabla ya kuvituma kwa wateja. Zima alama hii ili kupokea maoni ghafi ya mkondo wa juu.

SKILLS_SANDBOX_NETWORK_ENABLED.description: Wezesha ufikiaji wa mtandao katika sandbox ya ujuzi.

STREAM_RECOVERY_ENABLED.description: Jaribu tena kwa uwazi mikondo ya SSE ya mkondo wa juu iliyokatishwa kabla ya baiti zozote za jibu kumfikia mteja.

STREAM_RECOVERY_MIDSTREAM_ENABLED.description: Ruhusu urejesho wa mkondo kuomba jibu tena na kuliunganisha baada ya baiti kuwa tayari zimefikia mteja.

TOOL_POLICY_MODE.description: Weka hali ya utekelezaji wa sera ya matumizi ya zana.

legal.privacyMetadataDescription: Privacy policy for the OmniRoute AI API proxy router.
legal.privacySection1Text: OmniRoute is designed as a local-first application. All data processing and storage occurs entirely on your machine. There is no centralized server collecting your information.
legal.privacySection3Text: OmniRoute does not collect telemetry, analytics, or crash reports. No data is sent to us or any third party. Your usage patterns, API calls, and configurations remain entirely private.
legal.privacySection4Text: When you make API calls through OmniRoute, your requests are forwarded to the AI providers you have configured (for example: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). These providers have their own privacy policies that govern how they handle your data. Please review:
legal.privacySection5Text: If you enable the optional cloud sync feature, provider configurations and API keys may be transmitted to a configured cloud endpoint. This feature is disabled by default and requires explicit opt-in.
legal.privacySection7TextEnd: directory or using the database backup and restore features in the dashboard.
legal.privacySection7TextStart: Since all data is stored locally, you have full control. You can delete your data at any time by removing the
legal.termsDataLocationText: Usage logs, API keys, and configuration are stored in
legal.termsDataStoredLocally: All data is stored locally on your machine in a SQLite database.
legal.termsMetadataDescription: Terms of service for the OmniRoute AI API proxy router.
legal.termsNoTransmission: OmniRoute does not transmit any data to external servers unless you explicitly enable cloud sync features.
legal.termsResponsibilityApiKeys: You are solely responsible for managing your own API keys and credentials for third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.).
legal.termsResponsibilityCompliance: You must comply with the terms of service of each AI provider whose API you access through OmniRoute.
legal.termsResponsibilitySecurity: You are responsible for the security of your local OmniRoute installation, including setting a password and restricting network access.
legal.termsSection1Text: OmniRoute is a local-first AI API proxy router that operates entirely on your machine. It routes requests to multiple AI providers with load balancing, failover, and usage tracking.
legal.termsSection3Text: OmniRoute acts as an intermediary proxy. API calls sent to OmniRoute are translated and forwarded to your configured AI providers. OmniRoute does not modify the content of your requests or responses beyond the necessary protocol translation.
legal.termsSection5Text: OmniRoute is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not responsible for any costs incurred through API usage, service disruptions, or data loss. Always maintain backups of your configuration.
legal.termsSection6Text: OmniRoute is open-source software. You are free to inspect, modify, and distribute it under the terms of its license.

concept.description: OmniRoute hujifunza kutoka kwa kila mazungumzo, ikikumbuka ukweli, matukio, taratibu, na dhana za kisemantiki zinazofanya majibu kuwa sahihi zaidi na yanayozingatia muktadha.
concept.howWorksContent:
1. Uchimbaji wa kiotomatiki: mwishoni mwa kila jibu, ukweli na matukio hutambuliwa na kuhifadhiwa kiotomatiki.
2. Urejeshaji: kabla ya kila jibu, kumbukumbu zinazofaa zaidi hutafutwa kupitia FTS5 (halisi), vekta (kisemantiki), au mseto wa RRF.
3. Uingizaji: kumbukumbu husika huingizwa kwenye muktadha wa msaidizi ili kuboresha ubora wa majibu.
4. Usimamizi: tumia ukurasa huu kutazama, kuhariri, kuhamisha, na kubana kumbukumbu za zamani.
concept.title: Kumbukumbu ya Mazungumzo

oauthModal.deviceCodeVisitUrl: Visit the URL below and enter code:
oauthModal.googleLoopbackHeadlessAlt: __MISSING__:For fully headless use with no local callback at all, configure your own Google OAuth credentials plus a public base URL.
oauthModal.googleLoopbackHelperNote: __MISSING__:It opens the Google consent locally (where 127.0.0.1 works) and prints a one-line omniroute-cred-v1.… blob. Paste that blob into the Step 2 field below — it accepts a credential blob as well as a callback URL.
oauthModal.googleLoopbackRecommended: __MISSING__:Recommended — run this on your own computer, then paste the result below:
oauthModal.googleLoopbackTitle: __MISSING__:Google sign-in can't complete from this address
oauthModal.googleLoopbackTunnelLabel: __MISSING__:Or forward the dashboard port over SSH and reload OmniRoute through the tunnel:
oauthModal.googleLoopbackTunnelNote: __MISSING__:Replace {userPlaceholder} with your SSH username, keep the terminal open, then open {localUrl} and connect again from there.
oauthModal.googleLoopbackWhatHappens: __MISSING__:Google only releases the authorization code once {redirectUri} is reachable from the browser that approves the sign-in. Here that address points at this computer, not at the OmniRoute server — so the consent screen hangs instead of redirecting, and there is no callback URL to copy.
oauthModal.googleOAuthWarning: Remote access + Google OAuth: Default credentials only accept redirects to localhost. After authorizing, your browser will try to open localhost — copy that full URL and paste it below. For fully remote use without this manual step, configure your own OAuth credentials.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchAlternative: __MISSING__:No SSH access? If this provider offers a token import tab, connect with a token instead — that path doesn't use a loopback callback.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchExplanation: __MISSING__:After you approve the login, {providerName} always sends the browser back to {redirectUri}. That address points at the computer running this browser, not at the OmniRoute server — so the authorization code never reaches OmniRoute and the provider fails the sign-in without showing an error.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep1: __MISSING__:On this computer, open a terminal and start an SSH tunnel to the OmniRoute server:
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep1Note: __MISSING__:Replace {userPlaceholder} with your SSH username. Keep this terminal open until the connection shows as active — both ports are needed: one serves the dashboard, the other receives the callback.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep2: __MISSING__:In this browser, reopen OmniRoute through the tunnel:
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep3: __MISSING__:Then connect {providerName} again from the new tab. The callback now reaches the server and the login completes normally.

omniglyph.description: Mfinyazo wa muktadha-kama-picha. Inatoa kidokezo cha mfumo, nyaraka za zana, na historia mnene kama kurasa fupi za PNG ambazo Claude Fable 5 husoma badala ya maandishi. Tokeni za picha hutozwa kwa vipimo badala ya herufi, kwa hivyo kizuizi kilichobadilishwa kinagharimu takriban mara 10 chini. Njia ya moja kwa moja ya Anthropic pekee.

Hii ni hakiki na inabaki imezimwa kwa chaguomsingi hadi uthibitishaji wa mwisho hadi mwisho ukamilike.

providers.compatUpstreamHeadersHint: High-privilege setting — same trust level as editing provider API credentials; only trusted admins should use it. Merged after OmniRoute adds auth from the provider API key. If a custom header uses the same name as an existing one (e.g. Authorization), your value fully replaces the auto-generated header (including the Bearer token) — the upstream only sees what you typed, not the key from settings. Misconfiguration can cause 401 or broken upstream auth. One row per header (e.g. extra Authentication for some gateways). Hover or focus the value to preview. Saves on blur, outside click, or closing this panel.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.360ai: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye ai.360.cn

onboardingProviderDescriptions.agnes: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye agnes-ai.com
onboardingProviderDescriptions.agy: Ingiza kuingia kwako kwa Antigravity CLI (`agy`) (bandika/pakia faili yake ya tokeni), tambua kiotomatiki kuingia kwa CLI ya ndani, au ingia kwa kutumia Google. Inashiriki mfumo wa nyuma wa Antigravity (ikijumuisha miundo ya Claude).

onboardingProviderDescriptions.alibaba: Unganisha Alibaba kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.alibaba-cn: Unganisha Alibaba (China) kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.amazon-q: Hutumia AWS Builder ID ile ile au mtiririko wa refresh-token ulioingizwa kama Kiro, lakini huweka miunganisho ya Amazon Q kando.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ant-ling: __MISSING__:Register and create an API key at the Ant Ling API console (https://chat.ant-ling.com/open), then paste it here. OmniRoute routes chat traffic to https://api.ant-ling.com/v1/chat/completions; the provider is OpenAI-compatible and also exposes an Anthropic-compatible surface.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.anthropic: Unganisha Anthropic kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.antigravity: Unganisha Antigravity kwa mtiririko uliopo wa OAuth.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.api-airforce: Pata ufunguo wako wa API kutoka https://panel.api.airforce — endpoint inayooana na OpenAI kwenye https://api.airforce/v1
onboardingProviderDescriptions.arcee-ai: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye arcee.ai
onboardingProviderDescriptions.azure-ai: Foundry inatumia muundo wa OpenAI v1 wenye majina ya usambazaji kama miundo. OmniRoute inasawazisha URL za rasilimali ya mzizi kwenye endpoints za v1 chat na /models.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.azure-openai: Tumia ufunguo wako wa API wa Azure OpenAI. URL ya msingi inapaswa kuwa endpoint ya rasilimali yako, kwa mfano https://my-resource.openai.azure.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bai: Ufunguo wa API wa Bearer kwa lango la LLM linalooana na OpenAI la b.ai (tofauti na TheB.AI). Fungua ufunguo kwenye https://docs.b.ai, kisha tumia https://api.b.ai/v1 kama URL ya msingi inayooana na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.baichuan: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye platform.baichuan-ai.com
onboardingProviderDescriptions.baidu: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye console.bce.baidu.com
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bailian-coding-plan: Unganisha Alibaba Coding Plan kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.baseten: Salio la majaribio la bure la $30 kwa makisio ya GPU
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bazaarlink: Fungua ufunguo wa bure wa API kwenye https://bazaarlink.ai — muundo 'auto:free' unaelekeza kwenye makisio yasiyo na gharama. Miundo yote inatumia muundo wa provider/model-name, k.m. xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bedrock: Ujumuishaji asilia wa Bedrock: ugunduzi wa miundo unatumia miundo ya msingi ya Bedrock na wasifu wa makisio, huku gumzo likitumia API za kikanda za Bedrock Runtime Converse/ConverseStream.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.black-forest-labs: Unganisha Black Forest Labs kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.blackbox: Kiwango cha bure: gumzo la msingi lisilo na kikomo pamoja na Minimax-M2.5, hakuna kadi ya mkopo inayohitajika
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bluesminds: Pata ufunguo wako wa API kwenye https://www.bluesminds.com — endpoint inayooana na OpenAI kwenye https://api.bluesminds.com/v1 yenye salio la bure la kila siku. Miundo ya VIP (Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) inatumia salio la pi.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.byteplus: Unganisha BytePlus ModelArk kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bytez: Salio la bure la $1, linasasishwa kila baada ya wiki 4
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cerebras: Majaribio ya Bure: tokeni 1M/siku, 30K TPM, 5 RPM — hakuna kadi ya mkopo.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.charm-hyper: Fungua ufunguo wa API kwenye https://hyper.charm.land, kisha ubandike hapa kama tokeni ya Bearer.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chenzk: Lango linalooana na OpenAI lenye orodha ya miundo ya moja kwa moja kwenye chenzk.top.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chutes: Ufunguo wa API wa Bearer kwa lango linalooana na OpenAI la Chutes.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.clarifai: Clarifai hutoa gumzo, majibu na /models zinazoendana na OpenAI kwenye /v2/ext/openai/v1. Miundo ya umma/jumuiya kwa kawaida huhitaji PAT; funguo zenye upeo wa programu hufanya kazi tu kwa rasilimali zilizo ndani ya programu hiyo.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.claude: Unganisha Claude Code kwa mtiririko uliopo wa OAuth.

OmniRoute probes /v1/openai/models and routes chat traffic to /v1/openai/chat/completions. Uses the current clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com host — the legacy clovastudio.apigw.ntruss.com endpoint is being deprecated.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.oci: OCI hutoa endpoints za gumzo na majibu zinazooana na OpenAI. Project ID ni ya hiari katika OmniRoute lakini inaweza kuhitajika kwa Responses na mitiririko ya kazi ya kiwakala.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ollama-cloud: Unganisha Ollama Cloud kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openadapter: OpenAdapter hutoa endpoint ya ukamilishaji wa gumzo inayooana na OpenAI katika https://api.openadapter.in/v1/chat/completions, ikijumuisha miundo 70+ ya chanzo huria (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, Llama, Mistral, …). OmniRoute hutumia itifaki ya OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openai: Unganisha OpenAI kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.opencode-go: Unganisha OpenCode Go kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.opencode-zen: Unganisha OpenCode Zen kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openrouter: Miundo ya bure kwa $0/token yenye kiambishi tamati cha :free - 20 RPM / 200 RPD
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openvecta: Salio la bure unapojisajili kwa ajili ya makisio yanayooana na OpenAI kwenye LLM, embeddings, na miundo ya kutoa hoja
onboardingProviderDescriptions.orcarouter: Unda ufunguo wa API (huanza na sk-orca-) kwenye https://www.orcarouter.ai, kisha ubandike kama tokeni ya Bearer. Endpoint inayooana na OpenAI iko kwenye https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ovhcloud: Unganisha OVHcloud AI kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.perplexity: Unganisha Perplexity kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.piapi: Unganisha PiAPI kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.pioneer: Salio la bure la matumizi la $75 — hakuna kadi ya mkopo inayohitajika
onboardingProviderDescriptions.plamo: __MISSING__:PLaMo is OpenAI-compatible at https://api.platform.preferredai.jp/v1. Built by Preferred Networks and optimized for Japanese. Docs are primarily in Japanese.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.poe: Poe hutoa gumzo na majibu yanayooana na OpenAI kwenye https://api.poe.com/v1, ikiwa na ukaguzi wa salio uliothibitishwa kwenye /usage/current_balance.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.pollinations: Kiwango cha bure kisicho na ufunguo: openai, openai-fast, openai-large, qwen-coder, mistral, deepseek, grok, gemini-flash-lite-3.1, perplexity-fast, perplexity-reasoning. Miundo ya kulipia (claude, gemini, midijourney) inahitaji ufunguo wa API wa Pollinations kutoka enter.pollinations.ai.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.predibase: Salio la majaribio ya bure la $25 (uhalali wa siku 30)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.publicai: Inahitaji ufunguo wa API — salio la mara moja la kujisajili, kisha ya kulipia
onboardingProviderDescriptions.puter: Pata tokeni kwenye puter.com/dashboard → Copy Auth Token
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qianfan: Tumia ufunguo wa API wa Qianfan kutoka Baidu AI Cloud. Endpoint chaguomsingi inaoana na OpenAI v2.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qiniu: Unda ufunguo wa API wa makisio ya Qiniu AI kwenye https://portal.qiniu.com/ai-inference/api-key, kisha ubandike hapa kama tokeni ya Bearer. Endpoint inayooana na OpenAI iko kwenye https://api.qnaigc.com/v1, ikifanya kazi kama proksi ya DeepSeek, Claude, Kimi na zaidi nyuma ya ufunguo mmoja.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qwen: Unganisha Qwen Code na mtiririko uliopo wa OAuth.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.recraft: Unganisha Recraft kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.reka: Reka Chat inaoana na OpenAI kwenye /v1. OmniRoute huchunguza /v1/models na kuelekeza trafiki ya gumzo kwenye /v1/chat/completions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.requesty: Unda ufunguo wa API kwenye https://app.requesty.ai, kisha ubandike hapa kama tokeni ya Bearer. Endpoint inayooana na OpenAI iko kwenye https://router.requesty.ai/v1, ikiwa na orodha ya moja kwa moja ya /v1/models.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.runwayml: Uzalishaji wa video wa Runway unategemea kazi. OmniRoute huwasilisha kazi za maandishi-hadi-video au picha-hadi-video, huangalia mara kwa mara /v1/tasks/[id], na kurekebisha matokeo ya video yaliyokamilika kurudi kwenye jibu la /v1/videos/generations linalofanana na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sambanova: Salio la bure la $5 unapojisajili (uhalali wa siku 30), hakuna kadi ya mkopo inayohitajika
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sap: Ugunduzi wa miundo hutumia /v2/lm/scenarios/foundation-models/models kwenye AI_API_URL. Maombi ya gumzo hutumia deploymentUrl/chat/completions na yanahitaji AI-Resource-Group.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sarvam: __MISSING__:Sarvam AI is OpenAI-compatible on /v1. OmniRoute probes /v1/models and routes chat traffic to /v1/chat/completions. Models are tuned for Indic languages.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.scaleway: Tokeni 1M za bure kwa akaunti mpya — inatii EU/GDPR (Paris), Qwen3 235B & Llama 70B
onboardingProviderDescriptions.segmind: Zalisha picha na video kwa kutumia miundo iliyopangishwa ya Segmind.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sensenova: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye platform.sensenova.cn
onboardingProviderDescriptions.siliconflow: Salio la bure la $1 pamoja na miundo ya bure kabisa baada ya uthibitishaji wa kitambulisho
onboardingProviderDescriptions.snowflake: Unganisha Snowflake Cortex kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sparkdesk: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye console.xfyun.cn
onboardingProviderDescriptions.stability-ai: Unganisha Stability AI kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.stepfun: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye platform.stepfun.com
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sumopod: SumoPod hutoa endpoint ya ukamilishaji wa gumzo inayooana na OpenAI katika https://ai.sumopod.com/v1/chat/completions, pamoja na orodha ya moja kwa moja ya /v1/models. OmniRoute hutumia itifaki ya OpenAI na huorodhesha miundo kupitia passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.suno: Bandika kuki ya kipindi kutoka suno.ai (Clerk auth)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.synthetic: Unganisha Synthetic kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.tencent: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye console.cloud.tencent.com
onboardingProviderDescriptions.thebai: Ufunguo wa API wa Bearer kwa ajili ya lango la TheB.AI linalooana na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.together: Unganisha Together AI kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.tokenrouter: TokenRouter hutoa endpoint ya ukamilishaji wa gumzo inayooana na OpenAI katika https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1/chat/completions, pamoja na orodha inayofanya kazi ya /v1/models. OmniRoute hutumia itifaki ya OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.topaz: Unganisha Topaz kwa kutumia ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.typhoon: __MISSING__:Typhoon is OpenAI-compatible on /v1. Built by SCB 10X (Thailand); typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct is a thai-first, multilingual model.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.udio: Bandika kuki ya kipindi kutoka udio.com (Supabase auth)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.uncloseai: Hakuna uthibitishaji unaohitajika. API inakubali mfuatano wowote usio mtupu kama ufunguo wa utambulisho.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.upstage: Unganisha Upstage kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.v0-vercel: Unganisha v0 (Vercel) kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.venice: Unganisha Venice.ai kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vercel-ai-gateway: Unganisha Vercel AI Gateway kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vertex: Toa Service Account JSON au access_token ya OAuth
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vertex-partner: Toa Service Account JSON ile ile inayotumika kwa miundo ya washirika ya Vertex AI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.volcengine: Unganisha Volcengine kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.voyage-ai: Ufunguo wa API wa Bearer kwa ajili ya vipachiko na API za rerank za Voyage AI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.wandb: Unganisha Weights & Biases Inference kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.watsonx: Lango la modeli la watsonx linaweka wazi /chat/completions na /models zinazoendana na OpenAI chini ya /ml/gateway/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.writer: __MISSING__:Writer Palmyra is OpenAI-compatible at https://api.writer.com/v1. palmyra-x5 offers a 1M-token context window.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.x5lab: X5Lab hutoa endpoint ya ukamilishaji wa gumzo inayooana na OpenAI kwenye https://api.x5lab.dev/v1/chat/completions, pamoja na orodha ya moja kwa moja ya /v1/models. OmniRoute hutumia itifaki ya OpenAI na kuorodhesha miundo kupitia passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.xai: Unganisha xAI (Grok) kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.xiaomi-mimo: Unganisha Xiaomi MiMo kwa ufunguo wa API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.yi: Pata ufunguo wa API kwenye platform.lingyiwanwu.com
onboardingProviderDescriptions.zenmux: ZenMux hutoa endpoint ya ukamilishaji wa gumzo inayooana na OpenAI kwenye /api/v1/chat/completions, pamoja na nyuso za itifaki za Anthropic Messages (/api/anthropic/v1/messages) na Google Gemini (/api/vertex-ai). OmniRoute hutumia itifaki ya OpenAI.

riskNotice.deprecated: Mtoa huduma huyu alisitishwa na upstream yake na anaweza kuacha kufanya kazi bila taarifa. Muunganisho uliopo unaweza kuendelea kufanya kazi hadi upstream iondoe kabisa ufikiaji. Fikiria njia mbadala.
riskNotice.dontShowAgain: Usionyeshe hii tena kwa mtoa huduma huyu
riskNotice.oauth: Mtoa huduma huyu anatumia kipindi chako rasmi cha bidhaa/OAuth, ambacho hakijaidhinishwa kwa matumizi ya proksi/ruta. Hatupendekezi matumizi makubwa ya ejenti inayojitegemea (mtindo wa OpenCloud, mtiririko mrefu wa hatua nyingi, makundi makubwa) — upstream inaweza kuchukua hatua kwa kuzuia au kupiga marufuku akaunti. Tumia kwa hatari yako mwenyewe.
riskNotice.title: Kabla ya kuendelea
riskNotice.tooltip: Mtoa huduma aliye na tahadhari za matumizi — bofya kwa maelezo zaidi
riskNotice.webCookie: Mtoa huduma huyu anathibitisha kupitia kuki za kipindi chako cha wavuti. Huduma ya upstream inaweza kubatilisha kipindi wakati wowote, ikikuhitaji uingie tena. Haipendekezwi kwa shughuli ndefu zisizosimamiwa. Tumia kwa hatari yako mwenyewe.

providers.singleConnectionPerCompatible: Only one connection is allowed per compatible node. Add another node if you need more connections.
providers.t3ChatWebCookieHint: Fungua t3.chat → DevTools → Programu → Hifadhi ya Ndani → https://t3.chat, nakili 'convex-session-id'. Kisha ufungue DevTools → Mtandao, nakili kichwa kamili cha Kidakuzi kutoka kwa ombi lolote la gumzo. Bandika thamani zote mbili katika sehemu zilizo hapa chini.
providers.targetFormatHint: Batilisha umbizo la waya la upstream. Tumia 'Anthropic Messages' kuelekeza watoa huduma wanaoendana na OpenAI (k.m. opencode-go) kupitia endpoint ya /v1/messages.
providers.testAllModelsConfirm: Jaribu mifano yote inayoonekana? Mifano iliyofeli itafichwa ikiwa ufichaji wa kiotomatiki umewezeshwa.

providers.tierOverrideHelpText: Bandika mtoa huduma huyu kwenye kiwango cha uelekezaji badala ya kuruhusu OmniRoute kuamua kutoka kwa bei ya mfano.

providers.webCookieCredentialHint: Kidakuzi kinachohitajika: {credential}. Bandika thamani ya kichwa cha Kidakuzi kutoka kwa kipindi chako cha wavuti cha {provider} ulichoingia. Usijumuishe Kidakuzi: kiambishi awali.
providers.webCookieEditHint: Acha wazi ili kuweka kidakuzi cha kipindi cha sasa. Kidakuzi kinachohitajika: {credential}.
providers.webCookieProvidersDesc: Watoa huduma hawa hutumia vipindi vya wavuti vya kivinjari, vidakuzi, au tokeni za wavuti badala ya vitufe vya API. Fungua mtoa huduma ili kuongeza kitambulisho kinachohitajika cha kipindi.
providers.webFetchProvidersDesc: Watoa huduma wanaochukua na kutoa maudhui kutoka kwa URL za wavuti. Zitumie kuweka msingi wa vidokezo kwa data ya moja kwa moja ya wavuti.
providers.webFetchTooltip: Watoa huduma wanaochimba maudhui kutoka kwa URL za wavuti (HTML → Markdown, scrape, screenshot)
providers.webNoAuthGuideBody: {provider} haihitaji ufunguo wa API au kidakuzi. Hifadhi muunganisho ili utumie mwisho wake wa wavuti bila malipo.
providers.webSessionCredentialValidationFailed: Uthibitishaji wa kitambulisho cha kipindi umeshindwa. Ingia tena, nakili kitambulisho kipya, na ujaribu tena.
providers.webSessionGuideIntro: {provider} hutumia kipindi cha wavuti cha kivinjari badala ya ufunguo wa API.
providers.webSessionGuideStep2: Fungua zana za msanidi wa kivinjari na uangalie ombi lililotolewa na programu ya wavuti.
providers.webSessionGuideStep3: Nakili kitambulisho kinachohitajika kutoka kwa kikoa cha mtoaji mwenyewe. Kwa vidakuzi, nakili tu thamani ya kichwa cha Kuki na uache Cookie:.
providers.webSessionGuideStep4: Ibandike hapa na uangalie muunganisho. Ikiacha kufanya kazi, ingia tena na uibadilishe kwa thamani mpya.
providers.webSessionGuideTitle: Jinsi ya kupata kitambulisho cha kikao
providers.webSessionSecurityHint: Lichukulie hili kama nenosiri: linaweza kufikia akaunti yako ya wavuti uliyoingia hadi itakapoisha au kubatilishwa.
providers.webTokenCredentialHint: Kitambulisho: {credential}. Bandika thamani ya tokeni kutoka kwa kipindi chako cha wavuti cha {provider} ulichoingia, au uhamishaji wa DevTools HAR ikiwa mtoa huduma ataitumia.
providers.webTokenEditHint: Acha wazi ili kuweka tokeni ya sasa ya kipindi cha wavuti. Kitambulisho: {credential}.

settings.resilienceUseUpstream429BreakerHintsDesc: Tekeleza mawimbi ya Jaribu tena Baada ya / kiasi-kuisha kutoka kwa majibu 429 hadi muda wa kupoeza kwa kivunja mzunguko. Chaguomsingi hutumia sera ya kila mtoaji: watoa huduma za wingu moja kwa moja huwashwa; wakala wa nyuma, mwenyeji mwenyewe, na watoa huduma wanaoungwa mkono na CLI wamezimwa chaguomsingi. Haitegemei "Tumia vidokezo vya kujaribu tena juu ya mkondo".
settings.resilienceUseUpstreamRetryHintsDesc: Hutumia kujaribu-baada/kuweka upya thamani kutoka kwa mtoa huduma wa juu inapopatikana.
settings.resilienceUseUpstreamRetryHintsLabel: Tumia vidokezo vya kujaribu tena mkondo wa juu
settings.resilienceWaitForCooldownDesc: Hii inaathiri tu ombi la sasa. Haihifadhi muunganisho au hali ya mtoa huduma.

settings.responsesStateHint: Otomatiki huondoa previous_response_id isipokuwa muunganisho uwezeshe wazi hifadhi ya OpenAI Responses. Ondoa ni salama zaidi kwa wateja wasio na hali kama vile VS Code Custom Endpoint; muktadha basi hutegemea mteja kutuma historia kamili.

settings.routingAdvancedGuideHint1: Use Fill First for predictable priority, Round Robin for fairness, and P2C for latency resilience.
settings.routingAdvancedGuideHint2: If providers vary in quality/cost, start with Cost Opt for background work and Least Used for balanced wear.
settings.routingAllOccurrencesHint: Wakati IMEWASHWA (chaguo-msingi), kila tukio hubadilishwa. Wakati IMEZIMWA, ni ulinganisho wa kwanza tu unaobadilishwa.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureBypassDesc: Kubali saini zilizotolewa na mteja baada ya uthibitishaji mwepesi na urudie saini iliyohifadhiwa wakati si halali.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureBypassStrictD: Hitaji uthibitishaji kamili wa protobuf kabla ya kukubali saini iliyotolewa na mteja.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureDesc: Dhibiti ikiwa OmniRoute itatumia tena saini za fikra za Gemini zilizohifadhiwa pekee au itakubali saini zilizotolewa na mteja zilizothibitishwa katika mtiririko wa simu za zana unaoendana na Antigravity.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureEnabledDesc: Tabia ya sasa. Puuza saini zilizotolewa na mteja na uendelee kutumia mtiririko wa OmniRoute uliohifadhiwa.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureTitle: Njia ya Akiba ya Sahihi ya Antigravity
settings.routingBillingCchAlgoHint: Jinsi tokeni ya cch= ya herufi 5 inavyokokotolewa. 'sha256-first-user' = sha256 ya maandishi ya ujumbe wa kwanza wa mtumiaji. 'xxhash64-body' = utiaji saini wa kiwango cha bodi huijaza baadaye. 'static-zero' = kishikilia nafasi halisi cha '00000'.
settings.routingBillingEntrypointHint: Thamani iliyoingizwa kama 'cc_entrypoint='. Anthropic inakubali 'sdk-cli' (Agent SDK), 'cli' (Claude Code CLI), au thamani zingine zilizoandikwa kwenye nyaraka.
settings.routingBillingVersionFormatHint: Jinsi hashi ya uundaji ya herufi 3 baada ya cc_version= inavyokokotolewa. 'ex-machina' = sha256 ya CCH_SALT+herufi-kutoka-ujumbe-wa-kwanza-wa-mtumiaji+toleo (kwa kila ujumbe). 'omniroute-daystamp' = sha256 ya YYYY-MM-DD+toleo (thabiti kwa siku).
settings.routingBlockTextHint: Maandishi kamili ya kitalu kipya cha mfumo. Tumia mfuatano halisi wa herufi; kitalu cha mfumo huhifadhi maandishi pekee.
settings.routingCaseSensitiveHint: Wakati IMEWASHWA, 'OpenCode' na 'opencode' ni mifuatano tofauti. Wakati IMEZIMWA (chaguo-msingi), ulinganishaji hupuuza herufi kubwa au ndogo.
settings.routingClientCacheControlAlwaysDesc: Tuma kila wakati vijajuu vya cache_control vilivyotolewa na mteja kwa watoa huduma wa juu jinsi vilivyo.
settings.routingClientCacheControlAutoDesc: Kwa mitiririko inayooana na Claude ya kipekee, hifadhi cache_control iliyotolewa na mteja jinsi ilivyo. Ikiwa ombi halina cache_control, OmniRoute haitaingiza alama zozote zinazomilikiwa na daraja kwa ajili ya utangamano wa seva mbadala ya wahusika wengine inayooana na CC.
settings.routingClientCacheControlDesc: Sanidi ikiwa OmniRoute itahifadhi alama za cache_control zilizotolewa na mteja
settings.routingClientCacheControlNeverDesc: Ondoa kila wakati vijajuu vya cache_control vya mteja na uruhusu OmniRoute kudhibiti uwekaji kache ambapo mitiririko ya mtoa huduma asili inasaidia.
settings.routingDefaultAutoVariantLKGP: Mtoa Huduma Mzuri wa Mwisho Anayejulikana
settings.routingDefaultAutoVariantLKGPDesc: Mtoa Huduma Mzuri wa Mwisho Anayejulikana
settings.routingHeaderFingerprintTitle: Alama ya vidole ya kichwa (kwa mtoa huduma)
settings.routingIdempotencyKeyHint: Hiari. Ikiwekwa, op hurukwa wakati kitalu ambacho maandishi yake yanaanza na ufunguo huu tayari kipo. Huzuia utangulizaji mara mbili wakati wa kujaribu tena.
settings.routingMatchLiteralHint: Kijisehemu halisi cha maandishi cha kupata. Hakuna sintaksia ya regex — herufi maalum kama . * ? huchukuliwa kama zilivyo.
settings.routingNeedlesHint: Orodha ya vijisehemu vya maandishi. Aya inalingana ikiwa ina YOYOTE kati yao. Ongeza moja kwa kila mstari kupitia 'Add entry'.
settings.routingObfuscateTargetsHint: Ni maeneo gani ya mwili wa ujumbe ya kukagua kwa ajili ya maneno: vitalu vya mfumo, ujumbe wa mtumiaji/msaidizi, na/au maelezo ya zana.
settings.routingObfuscateWordsHint: Maneno ya herufi ndogo ya kuficha. Uingizaji wa ZWJ hutumiwa bila kujali herufi kubwa au ndogo, kwa hivyo 'opencode' pia inalingana na 'OpenCode' na 'OPENCODE'.
settings.routingOpAppendSystemBlockDesc: Huingiza bloku mpya ya maandishi MWISHONI mwa safu ya mfumo. Tumia kwa nyongeza za urembo ambazo hazihitaji kuwa katika nafasi ya [0].
settings.routingOpDropBlockContainsDesc: Huondoa bloku NZIMA za mfumo (sio aya tu) ambazo maandishi yake yana mojawapo ya mifuatano midogo ya herufi iliyoorodheshwa. Tumia wakati bloku nzima ina alama za utambulisho na unataka iondolewe — k.m. maelezo yaliyoingizwa ya MCP-server.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphContainsDesc: Huondoa aya yoyote (bloku ya maandishi iliyotenganishwa kwa mistari mitupu) ndani ya kidokezo cha mfumo ambayo maandishi yake yana YOYOTE kati ya mifuatano midogo ya herufi iliyoorodheshwa. Tumia kuondoa alama za utambulisho za klayenti za wahusika wengine kama vile 'github.com/anomalyco/opencode' au 'docs.openwebui.com' ambazo kiainishaji cha Anthropic huwekea alama.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphStartsWithDesc: Huondoa aya yoyote INAYOANZA NA mojawapo ya viambishi awali vilivyoorodheshwa. Tumia kwa mistari ya utambulisho kama vile 'You are OpenCode' au 'You are Open WebUI' inayotangaza klayenti inayofanya wito.
settings.routingOpInjectBillingHeaderDesc: Hutanguliza kitalu maalum cha maandishi cha 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=...; cc_entrypoint=...; cch=...;' ambacho kiainishaji cha Anthropic hukihakiki. Kinahitajika kwa ncha za uwasilishaji za daraja la CC; kwa mtoa huduma asilia wa claude, OmniRoute tayari huingiza mstari wake wa malipo kwa hivyo op hii kawaida huwa ya ziada hapo.
settings.routingOpObfuscateWordsDesc: Huingiza herufi ya Zero-Width-Joiner baada ya herufi ya kwanza ya kila neno lililoorodheshwa, kwa hivyo 'opencode' inakuwa 'o‍pencode'. Inasomeka sawa kwa wanadamu lakini inakwepa ulinganishaji wa maneno wa kiainishaji. Inalenga vitalu vya mfumo, ujumbe wa mtumiaji/msaidizi, na maelezo ya zana.
settings.routingOpPrependSystemBlockDesc: Huingiza bloku mpya ya maandishi MWANZO mwa safu ya mfumo. Tumia kuongeza utambulisho wa SDK 'You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.' ambao kiainishaji cha Anthropic kinatarajia.
settings.routingOpReplaceRegexDesc: Hubadilisha maandishi yanayolingana na usemi wa kawaida (regular expression). Tumia unapohitaji ruwaza (madarasa ya herufi, nafasi wazi ya hiari, nanga) badala ya mifuatano midogo halisi ya herufi. Ruwaza yenye hitilafu hunaswa wakati wa runtime wakati op inapofanya kazi.
settings.routingOpReplaceTextDesc: Hubadilisha mfuatano mdogo halisi wa herufi na mfuatano mdogo mwingine halisi wa herufi. Tumia kwa vifungu vichochezi vinavyojulikana — k.m. andika upya 'Here is some useful information about the environment you are running in:' kuwa 'Environment context you are running in:' (kifungu kichochezi kilichothibitishwa kwa majaribio).
settings.routingOpSummaryCount: {count, plural, =0 {hakuna op} one {# op} other {# op}}
settings.routingPatternHint: Chanzo cha regex cha JavaScript. Usiweke kwenye alama za mshazari — andika tu 'foo(.*)bar'. Seva hukataa mifumo inayoshindwa kukusanywa.
settings.routingPrefixesHint: Orodha ya mifuatano ya herufi. Aya inalingana ikiwa inaanza na yoyote kati yao (nafasi tupu ya mwanzo huondolewa kabla ya kulinganisha).
settings.routingRegexFlagsHint: Alama za regex za JavaScript (g = mechi zote, i = haijali herufi kubwa/ndogo, s = nukta inalingana na mstari mpya, m = mistari mingi). Chaguo-msingi 'g'.
settings.routingReplacementTextHint: Mfuatano wa kubadilisha. Acha wazi ili kufuta ulinganisho. Toleo huhifadhi maandishi yanayozunguka.
settings.routingRuleHint: Add a rule like claude-opus* -> frontier-combo to automatically route requests.

howItWorks.customOnly: Inatumika tu kwa miunganisho ya endpoint maalum.
howItWorks.docsLink: Soma mwongozo kamili wa msanidi programu wa Webhooks
howItWorks.hmacRecipe: Ili kuthibitisha payload za webhook katika Node.js, kokotoa HMAC-SHA256 ya bodi ghafi ya ombi ukitumia ufunguo wako wa siri. Ilinganishe na kichwa cha X-Webhook-Signature ukitumia timingSafeEqual.
howItWorks.hmacRecipeBash: Uthibitishaji wa HMAC wa Bash: echo -n "$body" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$secret"
howItWorks.hmacRecipePython: Uthibitishaji wa HMAC wa Python: hmac.new(secret, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
howItWorks.retryNote: Uwasilishaji uliofeli hujaribiwa tena hadi mara 5 kwa exponential backoff.
howItWorks.step1: Chagua mtoa huduma wa muunganisho (k.m. Slack, Discord, webhook maalum) na usanidi maelezo ya muunganisho.
howItWorks.step2: Sanidi matukio ya mfumo ya kujiandikisha (k.m. hitilafu za ukamilishaji, mibadala ya modeli, au vikomo vya matumizi).
howItWorks.step3: Thibitisha usanidi kwa kutuma payload ya jaribio ili kuhakikisha kuwa endpoint inaipokea.
howItWorks.step4: Linda endpoint yako kwa kuthibitisha header ya X-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256 kwa kutumia siri ya webhook.
howItWorks.timeoutNote: Uwasilishaji wa Webhook una muda wa ukomo wa sekunde 10.
howItWorks.title: Jinsi Webhook Zinavyofanya Kazi
